headline: Binance Drained of $2.5 Billion Following Malware Attack via Job Ad
summary: Hackers utilized fake job advertisements to trick a Binance engineer into downloading malware, enabling a $2.5 billion crypto drain.
why: Major cybersecurity breaches involving top cryptocurrency exchanges undermine platform trust and impact market liquidity.

impacts.name: Binance Coin
impacts.why: Security breaches on the platform reduce investor confidence and weigh on associated crypto tokens.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar exploit exposes vulnerabilities in major crypto infrastructure, triggering widespread risk aversion across digital asset markets.
